# Frequentist Model

### Fit nls with customized function

$$
\text{Length ~} A+\frac{(B-A)}{1+e^{((x_{mid} + \beta * \text{side_ind} - x)/\text{scal})}}
$$

```{r}
fpl_customized <- function(x, A, B, xmid, scal, beta, side_ind){
  xmid_eff <- xmid + beta * side_ind
  A + (B - A) / (1 + exp((xmid_eff - x) / scal))
}
```

```{r}
WT_model_output <- list()

for (root_num in unique(rootData_WT$root)) {
  curr_root <- rootData_WT |> filter(root == root_num)
  curr_root$side_ind <- ifelse(curr_root$side == "Outer", 1, 0)

  y_min <- min(curr_root$Length)
  y_max <- max(curr_root$Length)

  start_vals <- list(
    A = y_min * 0.9,
    B = y_max * 1.1,
    xmid = median(curr_root$Midline),
    scal = diff(range(curr_root$Midline)) / 4,
    beta = -50
  )

  lower_bounds <- c(A = y_min * 0.5,
                    B = y_min,
                    xmid = min(curr_root$Midline),
                    scal = diff(range(curr_root$Midline)) / 10,
                    beta = -500)

  upper_bounds <- c(A = y_max,
                    B = y_max * 2.0,
                    xmid = max(curr_root$Midline),
                    scal = diff(range(curr_root$Midline)),
                    beta = 500)

  fit <- try(
    nls(
      Length ~ fpl_customized(Midline, A, B, xmid, scal, beta, side_ind),
      data = curr_root,
      start = start_vals,
      algorithm = "port",
      lower = lower_bounds,
      upper = upper_bounds,
      control = nls.control(maxiter = 1000, warnOnly = TRUE, minFactor = 1e-10)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    WT_model_output[[paste0("root_", root_num)]] <- fit
  } else {
    message(paste("Model failed for root", root_num))
  }
}
```

```{r}
WT_results <- data.frame(
  root = character(),
  A = numeric(),
  B = numeric(),
  xmid = numeric(),
  scal = numeric(),
  beta = numeric(),
  beta_p = numeric(),
  beta_sig = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(name in names(WT_model_output)){
  model <- WT_model_output[[name]]
  
  coef_info <- tidy(model)
  beta_row <- coef_info[coef_info$term == "beta", ]

  WT_results <- rbind(
    WT_results,
    data.frame(
      root = name,
      A = coef(model)["A"],
      B = coef(model)["B"],
      xmid = coef(model)["xmid"],
      scal = coef(model)["scal"],
      beta = coef(model)["beta"],
      beta_p = beta_row$p.value,
      beta_sig = ifelse(beta_row$p.value < 0.05, "*", "ns")
    )
  )
}

kable(WT_results, digits = 5, caption = "Wild Type Logistic Model Results")
```

==== FIX BASED ON TA COMMENT ===== $$
\text{Length ~} A+\frac{(B-A)}{1+exp(\frac{x-x_{mid}}{\text{scal}})}
$$

```{r}
fpl_side_scale_geno <- function(x01, a, b, x0, g0, g1, g2, g3, side_ind, isWT){
  A    <- exp(a)
  B    <- A + exp(b)
  xmid <- plogis(x0)
  scal <- exp(g0 + g1*side_ind + g2*isWT + g3*side_ind*isWT)
  A + (B - A) / (1 + exp((x01 - xmid) / scal))
}
```

```{r}
# 4-parameter logistic with constraints and side effect on growth (scale)
fpl_side_scale <- function(x01, a, b, x0, g0, g1, side_ind){
  A    <- exp(a)                 # >0
  B    <- A + exp(b)             # >A
  xmid <- plogis(x0)             # in (0,1)
  scal <- exp(g0 + g1*side_ind)  # >0
  A + (B - A) / (1 + exp((x01 - xmid) / scal))
}

# Same model but WITHOUT side effect (to get robust starting values)
fpl_base <- function(x01, a, b, x0, g0){
  A    <- exp(a)
  B    <- A + exp(b)
  xmid <- plogis(x0)
  scal <- exp(g0)
  A + (B - A) / (1 + exp((x01 - xmid) / scal))
}

WT_model_output <- list()

for (root_num in unique(rootData_WT$root)) {

  curr_root <- rootData_WT |>
    dplyr::filter(root == root_num) |>
    dplyr::mutate(side_ind = ifelse(side == "Outer", 1, 0))

  # Skip roots with too few points or no side variation
  if (nrow(curr_root) < 8L || length(unique(curr_root$side_ind)) < 2L) {
    message(sprintf("Skipping root %s: not enough data or 1 side only", root_num))
    next
  }

  # Scale Midline to [0,1] 
  xr <- range(curr_root$Midline, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_rng <- diff(xr)
  if (x_rng <= .Machine$double.eps) {
    message(sprintf("Skipping root %s: zero x-range", root_num))
    next
  }
  curr_root$Midline01 <- (curr_root$Midline - xr[1]) / x_rng

  y_lo  <- as.numeric(quantile(curr_root$Length, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE))
  y_hi  <- as.numeric(quantile(curr_root$Length, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE))
  y_lo  <- max(y_lo, .Machine$double.eps)
  y_rng <- max(y_hi - y_lo, .Machine$double.eps)

  # Midpoint x where response ≈ halfway between y_lo and y_hi
  y_half <- y_lo + 0.5*y_rng
  x_half <- curr_root$Midline01[which.min(abs(curr_root$Length - y_half))]
  if (!length(x_half) || is.na(x_half)) x_half <- 0.5

  # Stage 1: Fit base 4PL (no side effect) to get *stable starts*

  base_starts <- list(
    a  = log(y_lo),                       # A start
    b  = log(y_rng),                      # (B-A) start
    x0 = qlogis(pmin(pmax(x_half, 1e-6), 1-1e-6)),
    g0 = log(0.10)                        # baseline scale on [0,1]
  )

  # Bounds in transformed space (keep things in plausible regions)
  base_lower <- c(a = log(y_lo)      - 2,  # allow some flex below anchor
                  b = log(y_rng)     - 2,
                  x0 = qlogis(1e-4),       # xmid in (0,1)
                  g0 = log(1e-3))          # scal >= 0.001
  base_upper <- c(a = log(y_hi)      + 2,
                  b = log(max(y_rng, 1)) + 2,
                  x0 = qlogis(1 - 1e-4),
                  g0 = log(1.0))           # scal <= 1 on [0,1]

  base_fit <- try(
    nls(
      Length ~ fpl_base(Midline01, a, b, x0, g0),
      data = curr_root,
      start = base_starts,
      algorithm = "port",
      lower = base_lower,
      upper = base_upper,
      control = nls.control(maxiter = 1000, warnOnly = TRUE, minFactor = 1e-10)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (inherits(base_fit, "try-error")) {
    # retry: slightly inflate A/B and jitter xmid
    base_starts2 <- within(base_starts, {
      a  <- a + log(1.1)
      b  <- b + log(1.1)
      x0 <- x0 + rnorm(1, sd = 0.2)
      g0 <- log(0.05)
    })
    base_fit <- try(
      nls(
        Length ~ fpl_base(Midline01, a, b, x0, g0),
        data = curr_root,
        start = base_starts2,
        algorithm = "port",
        lower = base_lower,
        upper = base_upper,
        control = nls.control(maxiter = 2000, warnOnly = TRUE, minFactor = 1e-10)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
  }

  if (inherits(base_fit, "try-error")) {
    message(sprintf("Base model failed for root %s", root_num))
    next
  }

  # Stage 2: Add side effect on log(scale), reuse base estimates as starts
  cf <- coef(base_fit)
  scale_starts <- list(
    a  = unname(cf["a"]),
    b  = unname(cf["b"]),
    x0 = unname(cf["x0"]),
    g0 = unname(cf["g0"]),
    g1 = 0  # start with no side effect
  )

  # Bounds incl. side effect g1 (limits multiplicative change in scale)
  scale_lower <- c(base_lower, g1 = -2)    # exp(-2) ~ 0.14x baseline
  scale_upper <- c(base_upper, g1 =  2)    # exp( 2) ~ 7.4x baseline

  fit <- try(
    nls(
      Length ~ fpl_side_scale(Midline01, a, b, x0, g0, g1, side_ind),
      data      = curr_root,
      start     = scale_starts,
      algorithm = "port",
      lower     = scale_lower,
      upper     = scale_upper,
      control   = nls.control(maxiter = 2000, warnOnly = TRUE, minFactor = 1e-10)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  # Fallback: if still singular, freeze xmid at base and refit (reduces collinearity with scale)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    x0_fixed <- unname(cf["x0"])
    fit <- try(
      nls(
        Length ~ {
          # Inline version with fixed x0
          A <- exp(a); B <- A + exp(b); xmid <- plogis(x0_fixed)
          scal <- exp(g0 + g1*side_ind)
          A + (B - A) / (1 + exp((Midline01 - xmid)/scal))
        },
        data      = curr_root,
        start     = list(a = cf["a"], b = cf["b"], g0 = cf["g0"], g1 = 0),
        algorithm = "port",
        lower     = c(a = base_lower["a"], b = base_lower["b"], g0 = base_lower["g0"], g1 = -2),
        upper     = c(a = base_upper["a"], b = base_upper["b"], g0 = base_upper["g0"], g1 =  2),
        control   = nls.control(maxiter = 2000, warnOnly = TRUE, minFactor = 1e-10)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
  }

  if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    WT_model_output[[paste0("root_", root_num)]] <- fit
  } else {
    message(sprintf("Scale-with-side model failed for root %s", root_num))
  }
}
```

```{r}

transform_params <- function(coefs) {
  A     <- exp(unname(coefs["a"]))
  B     <- A + exp(unname(coefs["b"]))
  xmid  <- plogis(unname(coefs["x0"]))
  scal_inner <- exp(unname(coefs["g0"]))
  g1    <- if ("g1" %in% names(coefs)) unname(coefs["g1"]) else NA_real_
  scal_outer <- exp(unname(coefs["g0"]) + ifelse(is.na(g1), 0, g1))

  list(
    A = A, B = B, xmid = xmid,
    scal_inner = scal_inner,
    scal_outer = scal_outer,
    g1 = g1
  )
}

get_g1_p <- function(model) {
  td <- try(tidy(model), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(td, "try-error")) return(NA_real_)
  row <- td[td$term == "g1", , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(row) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  row$p.value
}
 
WT_results <- data.frame(
  root = character(),
  A = numeric(),
  B = numeric(),
  xmid = numeric(),
  scal_inner = numeric(),
  scal_outer = numeric(),
  g1 = numeric(),
  g1_p = numeric(),
  g1_sig = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (name in names(WT_model_output)) {
  model <- WT_model_output[[name]]
  coefs <- coef(model)

  tp <- transform_params(coefs)
  p  <- get_g1_p(model)

  WT_results <- rbind(
    WT_results,
    data.frame(
      root = name,
      A = tp$A,
      B = tp$B,
      xmid = tp$xmid,
      scal_inner = tp$scal_inner,
      scal_outer = tp$scal_outer,
      g1 = tp$g1,
      g1_p = p,
      g1_sig = ifelse(!is.na(p) & p < 0.05, "*", "ns"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}

kable(WT_results %>% arrange(root),
      digits = 5,
      caption = "Wild Type (WT) 4-Parameter Logistic Results with Side Effect on log(scale)")
```

```{r}
MU_model_output <- list()

for (root_num in unique(rootData_MU$root)) {

  # 1) Subset to one root and make side indicator (0=Inner, 1=Outer)
  curr_root <- rootData_MU |>
    dplyr::filter(root == root_num) |>
    dplyr::mutate(side_ind = ifelse(side == "Outer", 1, 0))

  # 2) Quick guards: enough points? both sides present?
  if (nrow(curr_root) < 8L || length(unique(curr_root$side_ind)) < 2L) {
    message(sprintf("Skipping MU root %s: not enough data or only one side", root_num))
    next
  }

  # 3) Scale Midline to [0,1] per root (stabilizes the scale parameter)
  xr <- range(curr_root$Midline, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_rng <- diff(xr)
  if (x_rng <= .Machine$double.eps) {
    message(sprintf("Skipping MU root %s: zero x-range", root_num))
    next
  }
  curr_root$Midline01 <- (curr_root$Midline - xr[1]) / x_rng

  # 4) Data-anchored starts (robust to outliers)
  y_lo  <- as.numeric(quantile(curr_root$Length, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE))
  y_hi  <- as.numeric(quantile(curr_root$Length, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE))
  y_lo  <- max(y_lo, .Machine$double.eps)
  y_rng <- max(y_hi - y_lo, .Machine$double.eps)

  # Midpoint guess = x where Length ~ halfway from y_lo to y_hi
  y_half <- y_lo + 0.5*y_rng
  x_half <- curr_root$Midline01[which.min(abs(curr_root$Length - y_half))]
  if (!length(x_half) || is.na(x_half)) x_half <- 0.5

  # Stage 1: base 4PL (no side effect)
  base_starts <- list(
    a  = log(y_lo),                              # A start (log-scale)
    b  = log(y_rng),                             # (B - A) start (log-scale)
    x0 = qlogis(pmin(pmax(x_half, 1e-6), 1-1e-6)),  # xmid in (0,1)
    g0 = log(0.10)                               # baseline scale on [0,1]
  )

  # Conservative bounds in transformed space
  base_lower <- c(a = log(y_lo) - 2,
                  b = log(y_rng) - 2,
                  x0 = qlogis(1e-4),             # keep away from 0/1
                  g0 = log(1e-3))                # scal >= 0.001
  base_upper <- c(a = log(y_hi) + 2,
                  b = log(max(y_rng, 1)) + 2,
                  x0 = qlogis(1 - 1e-4),
                  g0 = log(1.0))                 # scal <= 1 on [0,1]

  base_fit <- try(
    nls(
      Length ~ fpl_base(Midline01, a, b, x0, g0),
      data      = curr_root,
      start     = base_starts,
      algorithm = "port",
      lower     = base_lower,
      upper     = base_upper,
      control   = nls.control(maxiter = 1000, warnOnly = TRUE, minFactor = 1e-10)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  # One gentle retry if needed
  if (inherits(base_fit, "try-error")) {
    base_starts2 <- within(base_starts, {
      a  <- a + log(1.1)
      b  <- b + log(1.1)
      x0 <- x0 + rnorm(1, sd = 0.2)
      g0 <- log(0.05)
    })
    base_fit <- try(
      nls(
        Length ~ fpl_base(Midline01, a, b, x0, g0),
        data      = curr_root,
        start     = base_starts2,
        algorithm = "port",
        lower     = base_lower,
        upper     = base_upper,
        control   = nls.control(maxiter = 2000, warnOnly = TRUE, minFactor = 1e-10)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
  }

  if (inherits(base_fit, "try-error")) {
    message(sprintf("Base model failed for MU root %s", root_num))
    next
  }

  #  Stage 2: add side effect on log(scale) 
  cf <- coef(base_fit)
  scale_starts <- list(
    a  = unname(cf["a"]),
    b  = unname(cf["b"]),
    x0 = unname(cf["x0"]),
    g0 = unname(cf["g0"]),
    g1 = 0    # start with no side effect; estimator will move if supported
  )

  scale_lower <- c(base_lower, g1 = -2)   # exp(-2) ~ 0.14x baseline scale
  scale_upper <- c(base_upper, g1 =  2)   # exp( 2) ~ 7.4x baseline scale

  fit <- try(
    nls(
      Length ~ fpl_side_scale(Midline01, a, b, x0, g0, g1, side_ind),
      data      = curr_root,
      start     = scale_starts,
      algorithm = "port",
      lower     = scale_lower,
      upper     = scale_upper,
      control   = nls.control(maxiter = 2000, warnOnly = TRUE, minFactor = 1e-10)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  # Fallback: if still singular, fix midpoint at base estimate (reduces collinearity)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    x0_fixed <- unname(cf["x0"])
    fit <- try(
      nls(
        Length ~ {
          A <- exp(a); B <- A + exp(b); xmid <- plogis(x0_fixed)
          scal <- exp(g0 + g1*side_ind)
          A + (B - A) / (1 + exp((Midline01 - xmid)/scal))
        },
        data      = curr_root,
        start     = list(a = cf["a"], b = cf["b"], g0 = cf["g0"], g1 = 0),
        algorithm = "port",
        lower     = c(a = base_lower["a"], b = base_lower["b"], g0 = base_lower["g0"], g1 = -2),
        upper     = c(a = base_upper["a"], b = base_upper["b"], g0 = base_upper["g0"], g1 =  2),
        control   = nls.control(maxiter = 2000, warnOnly = TRUE, minFactor = 1e-10)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
  }

  if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    MU_model_output[[paste0("root_", root_num)]] <- fit
  } else {
    message(sprintf("Scale-with-side model failed for MU root %s", root_num))
  }
}
```
